observations: Function entry compares the object argument with BlitzMax NullObject 0x4f1ed0, not the native zero pointer.
Argument was zero at the fault; reading its +0xc field triggers the exception before string rendering.
Other callers read inventory/equipment array objects and call this function; this supports interpreting it as an item/detail display routine.
Caller return 0x496225 is immediately after the call at 0x496220. REA bytes show push [eax+edi*4+0x18] after loading the global array at 0x5a139c.
Fault-time EDI 0x659091f is not a plausible inventory index and equals the recent skill-hook returnAddress. A register/stack/transition-state issue is a strong hypothesis, not yet a proven cause.
limitations: Ghidra does not identify a containing function for 0x496225 or 0x4d950f; do not treat reconstructed broad pseudocode as complete source.
The latest skill observer samples hold the valid empty string 0x4f1c90, not a translated Frida allocation; those samples do not prove a use-after-free.
